thesis: Round 17 factorial cell. Form: a volatility-compression entry -- 10-day ATR under 2% of price while the 10-day EMA leads the 30-day inside a 200-day SMA regime filter -- exited when ATR expands past 5% or the regime filter breaks. Brackets: none. This card is one cell of a pre-registered 8x2x3 grid whose only purpose is to measure whether strategy form, the regime filter and the bracket policy each change a result by more than this programme's own measured noise floor of 21.2 percentage points. It is not a proposal to trade anything. Every parameter is the textbook constant frozen in app.evolution.ruleforms before this round was conceived; nothing here was tuned, and the universe is the mechanically defined GICS sector ETF set rather than any thesis-picked list, so that stock selection cannot flatter a form. See strategy-program/ROUND-17-PLAN.md for the pre-registration, the five falsifiable predictions and the correction applied across all cells.
entry: close > sma(200) and ema(10) > ema(30) and atr(10) / close < 0.02
exit: atr(10) / close > 0.05 or close crosses_below sma(200)
